description: This file contains functions and logic related to upgrading and copying configurations for a Linux-based embedded system. It includes platform-specific upgrade procedures, device handling, and image validation routines.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs upgrade process for SD boot devices, writing kernel and root filesystem.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles upgrade for devices using UBI partitions, updating the active system slot.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to SD boot device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Dispatches configuration copying based on device type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates whether the system's current image is supported for upgrade on the specific hardware.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry to perform the upgrade, choosing the appropriate method based on the device.
